title: The assembler
lines: In The Works, the assembler is a tier 5 research: a crafting hall of 3 by 3 tiles that makes anything a bench or a workshop makes, as fast as 9 of them.
It takes parts in on its back and both sides.

more.head: Numbers
points: The research takes 8,000 Timber folios and 6,000 Brass folios.
An assembler costs 400 Coins at grade I, 1,200 at grade II and 3,200 at grade III, and draws 36, 54 and 72 power.
It holds 9 times as many parts as a bench or a workshop.
Its items leave from the middle tile of its front. Where it makes more a minute than the belt there carries, its card says up to what the belt carries.
